original_test_intent: Validate that the selected BMC sends one precisely defined management message through an approved channel to the intended destination and returns/correlates the required response without reaching or modifying any unintended device.
original_method: The Master body is empty. Standard Send Message 0x06/0x34 is only an outer transport candidate; its channel/tracking options and complete encapsulated message determine the actual test and blast radius, so no payload may be synthesized from the title.
manual_activity: Engineer identifies the remote endpoint and route, approves every outer and inner message byte plus the resulting remote action, and owns recovery if the destination or response is not as expected.
required_inputs: Verified source BMC and protected OOB session
Channel number, medium and routing topology
Complete encapsulated protocol frame and checksums
Decoded intended remote operation and privilege
Independent recovery for both BMC and destination
safety_requirements: Do not clear logs, flags or queues
Reject generic, broadcast, discovery or guessed payloads
Decode the inner message before approval
Prove the destination is unique and non-production-impacting
Send once with a bounded timeout
Do not retry on NAK, timeout or malformed response
Do not send an automatic compensating command
Preserve outer and inner response evidence securely
agent_execution_scope: Verify BMC, channel route and destination
Validate outer options and inner frame/checksums
Explain the remote side effect and response path
Present exact request bytes for approval
Issue one protected Send Message request
Correlate command completion and tracked/remote response
Verify only the intended endpoint changed, if a change was approved
engineer_actions: Approve route, destination and inner operation
Confirm required privilege and security mode
Adjudicate transport acceptance versus remote execution

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly provides no command for the TBD row. Naming 0x06/0x34 alone would still omit the actual destination and operation and is not executable evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after full frame approval, issue one `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x34 <channel-options> <complete-message-data...>` and validate both outer completion and any required inner response; otherwise remain NOT EXECUTED.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Master TBD procedure/criteria and 10/5 metadata remain unchanged; no channel, message or response is treated as a default.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a protocol-aware frame builder that displays decoded route, destination, privilege and inner command beside immutable bytes, validates checksums and correlates exactly one response.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Provides a guarded candidate framework for an absent Master method while refusing to invent the message that defines the functional test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Outer command acceptance proves only that the BMC accepted a send request; target delivery and execution require independent correlated evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The inner frame may invoke any supported remote function, including state-changing operations. A channel number alone does not identify a unique destination, and a timeout does not show whether the remote action occurred.

project_override_considerations: A vendor bridge tool is equivalent only if the same route, destination, payload, security and response semantics are exposed. Hidden framing or automatic retries create a material coverage and safety difference.
expected_evidence: Verified source BMC, channel topology and unique destination
Approved decoded outer options and complete inner frame bytes
Outer completion plus correlated inner response or target-side evidence
Proof no unintended endpoint, queue, flag, log or configuration changed
Escalation record for timeout, NAK, checksum, route or destination mismatch

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master provides no procedure or criteria to conflict with the title. The missing payload and target are readiness gaps, not contradictory requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The transport operation and required safety boundary are clear. Execution is pending a fully specified route, payload, effect, response and recovery; the reviewer does not guess them.

review_improvement: Separates outer Send Message transport acceptance from the encapsulated remote operation, requires byte-level route/payload approval and demands target-correlated evidence instead of treating a BMC completion code as end-to-end success.
independent_technical_reasoning: Send Message is a container, not a single benign function. Two requests with the same outer command can address different buses and perform entirely different privileged actions. The review therefore cannot classify safety from 0x34 alone; it must decode and approve the route and complete inner frame, then distinguish BMC acceptance from remote delivery and execution.
